entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this helmet. I've been on hold for ten minutes. This is ridiculous.
I apologize for the wait time. I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones, order number is VF88761. Look, I don't want a big song and dance. I want a return label, and I want it now. The box is unopened, so it should be simple.

Okay, Mr. Jones, I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Trail Helmet purchased about 25 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

What does it matter? The color is completely wrong! The picture on the website was bright orange, and this thing is a dull, murky brown. It's a safety issue! I need a high-visibility color for the trails.

I understand your concern about visibility and safety. Our Trail Helmets are designed with MIPS technology for maximum impact protection, but I can certainly see why the color would be important to you for visibility.

Stop giving me a sales pitch and give me a return label! I've had it less than 90 days, the box is unopened, and your policy says I can return it. Are you going to do your job or do I need to speak to your manager?
There's no need for that, sir. I can resolve this for you. Let me just double-check our current return policy for you... Yes, I'm just confirming here.
This is unbelievable. If I don't have an email with a shipping label in the next two minutes, I'm posting this entire conversation on every review site I can find. Your service is a joke.

My apologies, Mr. Jones. You are correct. I've reviewed the policy, and since you're within the 90-day window, you are absolutely eligible for a full refund for the helmet. I've just initiated that return for you. The return label has been sent to the email on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Okay, good. That's all I wanted. Should have been the first thing you did. I have the email now. No, there's nothing else.
Perfect. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
